warmup.description: Gently prepare joints and muscles for low-impact, controlled compound movements.
movements: March in place with arm swings x 60s

main_exercises.name: Box Squat (Bodyweight or Light Dumbbell)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight or light load, focus on smooth, controlled tempo
main_exercises.form_cue: Sit back to the box with control and stand up by driving through heels

main_exercises.name: Incline Push-Up (Bench or Wall)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Choose an incline that allows 2-3 reps in reserve
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep body in a straight line and lower with control

main_exercises.name: Supported Dumbbell Row
main_exercises.load_guidance: Light to moderate load focusing on controlled pulling
main_exercises.form_cue: Pull elbow toward hip and avoid shrugging shoulders

main_exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift (Light)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Light load, prioritizing hinge pattern and hamstring stretch
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep spine neutral and hinge at hips with slight knee bend

main_exercises.name: Farmer Carry (Light Dumbbells)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Light load that allows upright posture and steady breathing
main_exercises.form_cue: Stand tall, keep shoulders relaxed, and walk with controlled steps

cooldown.description: Relax muscles and improve joint mobility after gentle full-body work.
movements: Standing quad stretch x 30s each side

phase_notes.menstrual: This gentle, joint-friendly session is ideal—keep movements slow and prioritize comfort over range or reps.
phase_notes.follicular: Use this session to build consistency and reinforce smooth, controlled movement patterns without pushing intensity.
phase_notes.ovulatory: Even with higher energy, keep the focus on joint-friendly control—this session supports recovery and movement quality.
phase_notes.early_luteal: Maintain steady effort and use this session to support recovery while staying active and consistent.
phase_notes.late_luteal: This session is supportive for lower energy days—focus on gentle movement and reducing joint stiffness without strain.
